arguments.Title: 경로 이탈 구간 충돌면 조사
arguments.Code: using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var v=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>(); result.Log("vehicle="+v.transform.position+" rotation="+v.transform.eulerAngles); foreach(var w in v.GetComponentsInChildren<WheelCollider>()) { WheelHit h; if(w.GetGroundHit(out h)) result.Log("wheel="+w.name+" hit="+h.collider.name+" point="+h.point+" normal="+h.normal); } for(int n=-20;n<=20;n+=5){var origin=v.transform.position+new Vector3(0,50,n);foreach(var h in Physics.RaycastAll(origin,Vector3.down,100)) result.Log("sample="+n+" hit="+h.collider.name+" y="+h.point.y+" normal="+h.normal); } SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.LookAt(v.transform.position,Quaternion.Euler(30,210,0),15,false,true); } }
